subject: Service account delegation, SAML assertion samples & inventory request
messages:
From: Asha Mehta <asha@healthsecure.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: sec_ops@healthsecure.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: service account inventory + delegation samples and SAML assertions

Hi Jordan / Naomi,

We are preparing the SOC 2 artifacts for our upcoming audit and need a short bundle from Redwood focused on service-account and delegated-admin controls. Specifically we'd like:

- A CSV export of current service accounts (name, owner, creation date, last-used, scopes/roles).
- A mapping of any delegated-admin roles (who can grant/revoke) with recent approval records.
- 2-3 sample SAML assertion files (redacted) that show attribute mappings your IdP issues to Redwood, ideally at different assertion timestamps.
- Any internal playbook or notes describing justification/redaction policy used when producing audit artifacts.

Please indicate estimated delivery and whether you can provide redacted samples versus synthetic ones. We can accept redacted real assertions as long as names/IDs are removed.

Thanks,
Asha Mehta
Senior Security Analyst
HealthSecure
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@healthsecure.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: service account inventory + delegation samples and SAML assertions

Asha — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the bundle. Quick notes / plan: 

- Service account CSV: we’ll produce a filtered export with owner and last-used timestamps. We will remove any PII from description fields. Stubbed filename: service-account-inventory.csv (will include column headers).
- Delegation mapping: Naomi will extract the delegated-admin roster and recent approval tickets (redacted ticket ids).
- SAML assertions: we can provide redacted assertion XMLs showing NameID and attribute statements; two real redacted samples + one synthetic sample for parity. Files: saml-assertions-sample.xml (3 entries inside).
- Playbook / redaction notes: we’ll include a short doc describing redaction rules and our approval workflow (delegation-playbook.docx).

Proposed ETA: deliver a secure Drive folder by EOD on Fri, 2025-06-13. If you need faster, tell us which items to prioritize and we’ll push those first.

Couple of questions for you before we package: 1) Do you want historical last-used beyond 12 months? 2) Any specific OU/tenant slices to include or exclude?

Irene — assigning Naomi to lead the artifact pull; if you can QA the redactions before upload that would be great.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Asha Mehta <asha@healthsecure.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: sec_ops@healthsecure.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:54:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: service account inventory + delegation samples and SAML assertions

Thanks Jordan — that timeline works. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Last-used: 24 months would be ideal (we want to spot dormant service accounts). If that generates too much noise, default to 12 months but call out older accounts separately.
- OU slices: include all production tenants; exclude staging/dev unless an account appears in production.
- Redaction: remove email addresses, internal IDs, and ticket text. Asha: re: assertion samples — please ensure timestamps remain realistic (we want to validate assertion lifetime/conditions).

Final ask: can you include a one-page timeline showing when the artifacts were pulled and redaction steps (for the SOC evidence log)? Would be helpful for auditors.

Appreciate it — goal is delivery by Fri EOD our time (which is roughly Fri 00:00 UTC / Thu evening PT).

— Asha
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Mehta <asha@healthsecure.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Jun 2025 10:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: service account inventory + delegation samples and SAML assertions

Asha — quick update and delivery plan (per your clarifications):

Delivered items (to be uploaded to the shared Drive link below by 14:00 EDT, Sat 2025-06-14):
- service-account-inventory.csv (includes last-used for 24 months; dormant flag added).
- delegation-playbook.docx (one-page summary + annex describing approval flow).
- saml-assertions-sample.xml (2 redacted real assertions + 1 synthetic; all timestamps preserved and lifetime conditions annotated).
- timeline.txt (simple audit timeline: extraction time, redaction reviewer, upload time).

Attachments referenced in the folder will be: saml-assertions-sample.xml (xml), service-account-inventory.csv (csv), delegation-playbook.docx (docx). We will redact emails/internal IDs per your guidance; ticket references will be replaced with redacted placeholders.

Drive folder (private link, shared to your sec_ops address): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HSeCureShared/SA-Delivery

If you want the CSV delivered directly to a secure SFTP instead of Drive, let us know and we’ll push it.

Thanks — Naomi will do the QA step before upload; Irene will confirm redaction checklist.

Jordan Blake
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: service-account-inventory.csv (csv), saml-assertions-sample.xml (xml), delegation-playbook.docx (docx)
